baseline_models.mechanism: The assertion of disclosed knowledge and the inward-sight branch of بصر make the speech an exposure of perception already available to Pharaoh.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to a knower makes Pharaoh's knowledge asserted rather than newly taught.
Heart-insight makes the signs inwardly apprehensible rather than merely visible objects.

changed_reading.before: Moses informs Pharaoh that the Lord sent signs.
changed_reading.after: Moses exposes Pharaoh as already recognizing the signs' source and perceptual force.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَا أَنزَلَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ
baseline_models.mechanism: Delivery from above is assigned exclusively to the sovereign of the upper and lower domains, so the signs arrive as an authorized transfer across the whole created field.

activation_trace.role: Caused delivery makes أنزل an act of conveyance, not bare downward motion.
Lordship and sovereignty identify the exclusive sender behind the transfer.
What is above and overshadowing supplies the upper pole of the sender's domain.
The lower realm opposite heaven supplies the receiving pole of the cosmic span.

changed_reading.before: The wonders descend from a divine source.
changed_reading.after: The signs are purposefully delivered under exclusive sovereignty spanning heaven and earth.

baseline_models.mechanism: The certainty-after-indication branch of ظن, following asserted knowledge and بصائر, joins the destruction branch of ثبر to form an evidence-bearing verdict rather than an idle guess.

activation_trace.role: Certainty reached after an indicator makes أظنك a warranted conclusion.
Ruin and destruction supply the verdict's strongest endpoint.

changed_reading.before: Moses tentatively suspects that Pharaoh is doomed.
changed_reading.after: Moses pronounces a sign-grounded expectation of Pharaoh's ruin.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ordered context moves from heart-blindness through visible signs being covered to seeing creation and refusing; علمت and بصائر therefore diagnose culpable nonresponse, not a shortage of evidence.

activation_trace.role: Disclosed recognition anchors the accusation in Pharaoh's asserted knowledge.
Heart-insight names the perceptual capacity whose nonresponse is at issue.
Blindness of heart and insight supplies the negative pole opposed to بصائر.
A visible mark establishes that the rejected material is evidentiary.
Covering the truth turns failed response into active concealment.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies recognition before the ensuing refusal.
Refusal supplies the volitional break between perception and assent.

structural_cues: 17:97 opposes guidance to blind, mute, and deaf perception; 17:98-99 then place rejection after signs and seeing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies perceptual loss, visible signs, sight, covering, and refusal; I infer a forensic arrow from recognition to culpable suppression. A live alternative is that 17:98-99 describes resurrection-deniers and only analogizes Pharaoh.

changed_reading.before: Pharaoh has been shown adequate proofs.
changed_reading.after: Pharaoh's knowledge is charged as perception deliberately covered and refused.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hypothetical human possession turns mercy-treasuries into hoarded stock; against it, the split-mapped nourishment of رب and the delivery branch of أنزل let the signs be heard as provision released rather than retained.

activation_trace.role: Possession and disposal establish hypothetical human custody of the treasury.
Safekeeping and storage make mercy a held reserve.
Mercy supplies the beneficial value of what custody would withhold.
Miserly retention supplies the blocked-outflow mechanism.
Nourishment and growth in the split mapping make lordship a cultivating counter-image.
Delivery supplies the released outflow of the perceptive signs.

structural_cues: The treasury-withholding sentence in 17:100 immediately precedes the nine signs and the focus attribution of their descent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies owned stores, mercy, withholding, cultivating lordship, and delivery; I supply an analogy from material outflow to revelatory giving. The live alternative is that mercy-treasuries and signs remain unrelated objects.

changed_reading.before: The Lord sends signs as demonstrations of power.
changed_reading.after: The sending can also be heard as generous release of perception, contrasting with human hoarding.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately prior finite gift of nine clear signs gives هؤلاء a concrete set, while later repeated descent, partition, and waiting sharpen أنزل as purposeful delivery in distinguishable stages.

activation_trace.role: Giving supplies the transfer by which the sign-set reaches Moses.
The number nine bounds a finite set immediately before هؤلاء.
Disclosure by statement or sign makes the given set explicitly evidentiary.
Delivery anchors the focus deictic set in an act of conveyance.
Repeated caused and intransitive descent reinforces purposeful arrival.
Division into parts supplies staged differentiation rather than one undivided event.
Waiting stability supplies paced reception between differentiated units.
The doubled descent form confirms delivery as an organized process.

structural_cues: 17:101 places a numbered clear set directly before the focus demonstrative.
17:105-106 repeat نزل after the focus and couple it with truth, differentiation, and waiting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the adjacent nine signs and a later pattern of paced descent; I infer that the former resolves هؤلاء and the latter sharpens the mode of delivery. The later descended object may differ, so the arrow is formal analogy, not referent identity.

changed_reading.before: These are unspecified wonders that came down.
changed_reading.after: These points to the finite clear sign-set, delivered as an ordered evidentiary intervention.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent speeches repeat إني لأظنك يا + addressee + passive predicate; Moses returns Pharaoh's accusation-frame but, after لقد علمت, converts its epistemic force into a counter-verdict under acknowledged evidence.

activation_trace.role: Suspicion and accusation make Pharaoh's أظنك a charge against Moses.
Diversion and deception supply the content of Pharaoh's charge.
Asserted disclosure creates the evidentiary asymmetry in Moses's reply.
Certainty after an indicator converts the echoed formula into a warranted judgment.
Destruction replaces bewitchment as the returned predicate and verdict.

structural_cues: 17:101-102 form adjacent turns with the same emphatic first-person frame, second-person object, vocative, and final passive adjective.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact syntactic echo and contrasting predicates; I infer deliberate polemical mirroring plus an arrow from acknowledged signs to a firmer reply. Both verbs could alternatively remain ordinary strong opinions without differentiated force.

changed_reading.before: Moses independently states an opinion about Pharaoh's doom.
changed_reading.after: Moses mirrors Pharaoh's accusation formula and turns it back as an evidence-based verdict.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pharaoh tries to destabilize the people out of the land, but he is drowned and they are told to settle it; this reversal activates مثبور not only as destroyed but as blocked and turned back from his intended outcome.

activation_trace.role: Being barred, prevented, or turned back supplies the frustrated-agency reading.
Destruction remains the primary layer completed by the drowning outcome.
Lightness that shakes stability supplies Pharaoh's intended displacement mechanism.
The lower land opposite heaven is the contested field from which removal is attempted.
Drowning as killing supplies the reversal that terminates Pharaoh's project.
Settlement in a dwelling gives the intended victims the stable outcome Pharaoh opposed.

structural_cues: 17:103 states intended removal, then drowning; 17:104 answers with the intended victims' settlement in the land.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attempted destabilization, drowning, and subsequent settlement; I infer a reversal arrow from Pharaoh's project to his own prevention. The alternative keeps B003 secondary and reads مثبور chiefly through destruction.

changed_reading.before: Pharaoh is simply destined for destruction.
changed_reading.after: Pharaoh is also the one whose expulsion project is barred and reversed through his destruction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later recipients of disclosed knowledge follow recitation into falling, prostration, and humility; Pharaoh's asserted knowledge stops before that response, activating the barred-from-good branch of مثبور as an arrested perceptual-to-bodily sequence.

activation_trace.role: Recognized disclosure anchors Pharaoh at the knowledge stage of the sequence.
Heart-insight supplies the inward faculty expected to continue into response.
Being barred from good supplies the blockage between knowing and yielding.
Those given disclosed knowledge provide the comparison group.
Following and succession turn recitation into the next step after knowledge.
Audible, agitated falling makes recognition bodily rather than merely mental.
Lowering in submission supplies the yielded posture absent from Pharaoh.
Humbling and submission complete the response trajectory.

structural_cues: 17:107-109 sequence prior knowledge, recitation, falling, prostration, and increased humility after the focus confrontation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a response sequence in knowledgeable hearers and asserted knowledge without such response in Pharaoh; I infer that مثبور can diagnose blockage along that sequence. The alternative treats the later hearers only as a separate exemplary group.

changed_reading.before: مثبور predicts only Pharaoh's external ruin.
changed_reading.after: It can additionally diagnose being barred at the threshold where recognized insight should become submission.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant وسم mapping of سمو and lets the later 'names' echo marking within 'heavens.' It remains anchored to the focus's سمو, علم, and بصر cluster, but downstream prose should present it only as a branch-driven associative overlay, never as an etymology or translation of السماوات.

activation_trace.role: A visible mark that makes something known overlays the heavens as a readable field.
The names occurrence reactivates marking and designation after the focus.
Disclosure to the knower gives the marked field an epistemic function.
Heart-insight makes those marks inwardly legible rather than merely decorative.

changed_reading.before: The heavens and earth only delimit the Lord's sovereign scope.
changed_reading.after: The heavens can additionally be heard as a marked, readable field through which lordship becomes knowable.

strongest_changes: Pharaoh's asserted knowledge becomes culpable covered perception rather than missing information.
The echoed أظنك formula becomes a deliberate counter-accusation whose force is asymmetrical because Moses invokes acknowledged signs.
مثبور retains destruction while gaining two contextual overlays: a reversed political project and blockage before submission.
أنزل هؤلاء resolves toward the finite nine-sign set and sharpens into purposeful, ordered delivery.
summary.what_was_special: The close sequence joined perception, accusation, delivery, displacement, and bodily response; split-root branches additionally exposed a provision model for رب and a contained marked-field overlay for السماوات without forcing either into the main lexical reading.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether ظن in the reply is certainty after indications or still strong conjecture.
Whether the prevention branch of ثبر can bear direct predicative weight or should remain secondary to ruin.
Whether the later descent sequence and the سمو/وسم echo should remain formal analogies rather than referential or etymological links.
